## Description

Update verify-work so agents assemble close-requests with red evidence and treat pass-only tdd as a refused close, matching close_batch.

## Approach

1. In `skills/verify-work/SKILL.md`, remove the claim that red-first is instruction-only / not engine-enforced.
2. Document the `tdd` close-request fields: `red_check_run_id` and copied fail fields; green must descend from red (or dirty red + `diff_sha256`); finding escape when closing without red.
3. Show the close-request JSON examples with the new fields; keep runner-authority rules for inventing pass/fail.
4. Run `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py -q` and add a narrow assert in `tests/test_assess_routing.py` (or existing skill doc test) if needed so the old "does not enforce" wording cannot return.
